newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Souza Cruz upped to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Souza Cruz upped to buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a report it has upgraded its rating on Brazilian cigarette maker Souza Cruz to buy from hold.
-- DMG analyst Dana Voelzke cited the company's faster than expected export growth and better than expected gains on operating efficiencies.

-- "Our earnings estimates for fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998 assume exports will grow 12.5 percent and 9.2 percent, as cigarette sales to emerging markets, in particular Eastern Europe, expand," Voelzke said.
-- The analyst said margins should improve as Souza Cruz continues to benefit fropm investment in productivity, resulting in EBITDA growth of 17 percent per year for the next two years.
-- DMG has set a price target of $10.69, representing an upside potential of 30 percent.
-- The investment bank said the target assumes per-share earnings this year of $0.43 and a standard dividend payout of 50 percent of net income.
-- Souza Cruz's common was off 0.43 percent at 9.30 reais at 1115 local time/1015 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
